name: maestro
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the Maestro Frontier fusion plugin.

plugins.name: maestro
plugins.description: Local multi-CLI Frontier fusion for AI coding agents. Fan a prompt across 1 to 8 local model CLIs, compare their answers with a judge, and produce one grounded synthesis. The current catalog includes Claude Opus 5 and OpenAI/Codex GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, Luna, Auto Review, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 Mini, and GPT-5.3 Codex Spark, with validated per-panel effort control. Single and fusion modes switch through /maestro:frontier. Optional discipline hooks remain available but are disabled by default.
